svg.aria-label: An agent writes a change, reviews its own diff, agrees with itself and commits, in a loop with nothing outside it that can refuse. Below it, the three reviewers that sit in that loop: the Grump on the diff, the Paranoid SRE on the deploy, and Tenured on the repository's own history.
svg.text: Your agent writes it, reviews it,
So I put three senior engineers in it. One of them can refuse the write.

g.text: reads the diff — what breaks in production
reads the deploy — what happens at 3 a.m.
reads the log — have we already tried this

svg.text: 2,000 recorded runs · four agents · scored by fixed checks written before any run
